title: fix(mcp): warn at add_tool when the tool's speed is outside the machine's spindle range
body:
## What changed

- `add_tool` (MCP) now returns a `warning` when the speed of the new tool is outside the spindle range of the mounted machine. Example: `EM-0300-2FL runs 15000 rpm, above the Tormach 770MX (ML)'s 10000 - the post will be held; set the tool's speed (edit_tool) or apply_cutting_data`.
- The UI shows the same text in the status line when a tool is added. The text comes after the holder note.
- The problem line of the machine check for an operation now names the fix: `Face1: tool EM-0400-2FL runs 12000 rpm, above the machine's 10000 - set the tool's speed (edit_tool) or apply_cutting_data`. The check of the default machine (#2321) uses the same words.
- The add does not change the speed of the tool. The machine check, the post gate and the posted G-code do not change.
- A finding for an NC line (`SourceLocation::NcLine`) keeps its old text. A posted NC file has no document tool to edit.
- The schema text of `add_tool` describes the new `warning` key.

Code:

- `crates/post/src/machine/check.rs`: the constant `SPINDLE_FIX`, the function `spindle_range_warning`, and one shared range test for the check and the warning.
- `crates/app/src/commands/tool.rs`: `AddTool::with_holder` reads the mounted machine and keeps the warning. `AddTool::warning()` returns it.
- `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs`: the reply key `warning`. The file stays at 412 lines.
- `crates/app/src/posting_default_machine.rs`: the same fix words.
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs`: the status line.

## Cause

Only the add of a tool took the catalog speed without a reading of the mounted machine. `apply_cutting_data` and the Feeds tab spindle row already say when the machine holds a speed. Thus the first word came from the machine check at verify, after the work was generated. That line did not name a fix.

## Tests

Pins:

- `crates/app/tests/mcp/add_tool_spindle_warning.rs` (in the `mcp` directory suite, no new test binary):
  - `add_tool_warns_of_a_speed_above_the_mounted_machine`
  - `add_tool_warns_of_a_speed_below_the_mounted_machine`
  - `add_tool_does_not_warn_inside_the_range_or_without_a_machine`
  - `verify_still_holds_the_post_and_names_the_fix`
- `crates/ui/tests/machine.rs`: `adding_a_tool_above_the_machines_speed_says_so_in_the_status`
- `crates/post/tests/machine_check.rs`: `pure_tool_checks_keep_rpm_sizes_and_distinct_tool_count` (expected text extended)
- `crates/app/tests/default_machine_limits.rs`: `no_mounted_machine_is_refused_above_the_default_spindle_maximum` (expected text extended)

Red before the fix: yes. On unchanged code the "above", "below" and "verify" pins failed. The reply had no `warning` (`left: Null`), and the verify line ended at `above the machine's 10000`.

Mutation results (each mutation was made, the pin ran red, the code was restored, the pin ran green):

| Mutation | Red tests |
|---|---|
| `add_tool` reply drops the warning (`mcp/edit.rs`) | the "above" and "below" pins |
| `AddTool::with_holder` computes no warning (`commands/tool.rs`) | the "above" and "below" pins, the UI pin |
| The machine check adds no fix (`machine/check.rs`) | the "verify" pin, `pure_tool_checks_keep_rpm_sizes_and_distinct_tool_count` |
| The old `posting_default_machine.rs` from `upstream/main` | `no_mounted_machine_is_refused_above_the_default_spindle_maximum` |
| The UI status drops the warning (`state.rs`) | the UI pin |

Three mutations were hand edits, not a copy of the old file. The old `mcp/edit.rs`, `commands/tool.rs` and `machine/check.rs` do not compile against the new callers.

Final checks for the screenshot review round (2026-11-25):

PR head: `7d4686af9528267a7f966ed1a307b27c4cb1779c`. No source commit was needed for this finding.

Current fetched base: `upstream/main` at `10ea81a2a1da2f883d43385757db802e83c99fd1`.

| Command or check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | RED. 377 executed steps: 376 passed, 1 failed, 0 stalled. The failed UI build skipped 15 UI suite steps. Wall time: 24.5 minutes. |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | RED. 67 steps: 66 passed, 1 failed, 0 stalled. Wall time: 31.6 minutes. |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | GREEN. |
| `app suites: example_catalog` | 43 passed, 4 ignored. |
| `app suites: example_catalog_adaptive` | 1 passed. |
| `app suites: example_catalog_edge_work` | 1 passed. |
| `app suites: solid_law_goldens` | 7 passed. |
| `app suites: mcp` | 54 passed. |
| UI status pin, with warning temporarily removed | RED. The status contained no spindle warning. |
| UI status pin, after restoration | GREEN. 1 passed. |
| Temporary shipping-layout capture test, before and after | GREEN. Both screenshots rendered with software Vulkan. |

The UI status pin is `adding_a_tool_above_the_machines_speed_says_so_in_the_status`.
The mutation removed only `.chain(command.warning())` from the UI status assembly.
The source was restored exactly after the RED run. The restored pin passed.
All temporary capture source was removed before the gates. The worktree is clean.

Quick failed during `ui build (--no-run)` with `E0463: can't find crate for camcraft_cl` at `crates/app/src/lib.rs:7:9`.
The errors also named `camcraft_geometry`, `camcraft_tools`, `camcraft_motion`, `camcraft_sim`, and `camcraft_post`.
The build reported 331 errors. A narrower retry and a retry without sccache failed with the same errors.
No cause was established. No build configuration or source was changed to address these errors.

Heavy failed in `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm`.
The test was `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`.
Its mesh assertion at `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:80` reported `left: 5232`, `right: 6228`.
This round did not change that test or its source. The failure was not checked on bare upstream/main.

## Goldens moved

None in this PR or this review round. The three catalog suites and `solid_law_goldens` ran and passed.
`git diff --name-only upstream/main...HEAD -- '*.nc' '*.cl' examples/catalog` is empty.
The current upstream branch has separate catalog changes; this PR does not include those changes.

## UI evidence

Both images show the catalog add of `EM-0300-2FL` with `Tormach 770MX (ML)` mounted. The tool keeps 15000 rpm.

The temporary test harness used the shipping shell layout and clicked the catalog Add button. The capture used software Vulkan.

Before: the UI warning was temporarily removed from the status assembly. The status contains the holder note.

![Before: catalog add without the spindle warning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/a8a13408bfcea24c4dcd205f99e1b1bf6b19a064/pr-3963/catalog-add-before.png)

After: the unchanged PR head shows the 15000 rpm / 10000 rpm warning and the suggested actions.

![After: catalog add shows the spindle warning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/a8a13408bfcea24c4dcd205f99e1b1bf6b19a064/pr-3963/catalog-add-after.png)

The images are stored only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `a8a13408bfcea24c4dcd205f99e1b1bf6b19a064`. No capture source or images were added to the PR branch.

## Not exercised

- The 15 UI suite steps skipped after the UI build failure. The capture test and status pin ran before the gates.
- A bare upstream replay of the gate failures. Their cause and regression status are not established.
- The light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`). I did not run it. The review runs it on the final head.
- A lathe machine and the tool-library import path. They use the same command and the same function.

## Overlaps

- #3946 (`feat(tools)`, `needs-rework`) changes one line in the same function, `add_tool` in `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs` (the `definition` branch, line 241). This PR changes the reply lines of that function (lines 269-279). The hunks are 28 lines apart and merge without a conflict. I did not stack on #3946: it is a 56-file `feat` that merges at a cut, and a stack would hold this fix until then. #3946 also changes `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs`, in a different hunk (line 31; this PR changes line 343). The PR that merges second refreshes.
- #3251 changes other functions in `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs` (`patched`, `opt_in_kept`). It touches the same file, different functions. The PR that merges second refreshes.

Effort: medium

Changelog: `add_tool` and the UI's tool add now warn at once when the tool's speed is outside the mounted machine's spindle range, and the machine check's rpm problem names the fix (edit the tool's speed or apply cutting data) (#3792).

Fixes #3792
